summary: Batch 31 — F&B Tab Transfer testing complete: Cross-outlet guest tab management (bar→restaurant→room folio). 32/33 backend tests passed (1 skipped), all frontend UI elements verified.
seed_data_creation: Test tabs created via API tests (TEST_Anna, TEST_DetailGuest, TEST_ItemsGuest, TEST_WorkflowAnna, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 31 F&B Tab Transfer fully tested. All 8 endpoints working: POST /api/fnb/tabs (open), GET /api/fnb/tabs/{property_id} (list with by_outlet aggregation), GET /api/fnb/tabs/detail/{tab_id}, POST /api/fnb/tabs/{tab_id}/items (add), DELETE /api/fnb/tabs/{tab_id}/items/{item_id} (remove), POST /api/fnb/tabs/{tab_id}/transfer (with audit log), POST /api/fnb/tabs/{tab_id}/close (with room_folio support), GET /api/fnb/tabs/transfers/{property_id} (audit), GET /api/fnb/tabs/dashboard/{property_id} (KPIs). Frontend FnbTabsPanel has 3 tabs (Açık Tab'lar, Transfer Geçmişi, Bugün Özet), outlet filter pills, tab detail with action buttons, add item/transfer/close forms all working.

backend: POST /api/fnb/tabs - invalid outlet returns 400 with valid list
POST /api/fnb/tabs - valid request returns doc with auto ref TAB-YYMMDD-HHMMSS-XXXX
GET /api/fnb/tabs/{property_id} - returns rows, count, by_outlet aggregation
POST /api/fnb/tabs/{tab_id}/transfer - same outlet returns 400 'Already at this outlet'
POST /api/fnb/tabs/{tab_id}/transfer - success updates outlet, adds transfer_history, writes audit
POST /api/fnb/tabs/{tab_id}/close - cash with tip/discount calculates total correctly
GET /api/fnb/tabs/dashboard/{property_id} - returns all KPIs (open_tabs, closed_today, revenue_today, tips_today, transfers_today, by_outlet_today, by_payment_today)
Full workflow: open → add items → transfer → add more → close with correct total calculation
Closed tab restrictions: cannot add items, transfer, or close again
frontend: FnbTabsPanel renders with Turkish title 'Tab Transfer & Folyo Aktarımı'
3 tabs: Açık Tab'lar (fnb-tab-active), Transfer Geçmişi (fnb-tab-transfers), Bugün Özet (fnb-tab-dashboard)
Outlet filter pills with Tümü + per-outlet counts (fnb-outlet-all, fnb-outlet-{outlet})
Open Tab form: outlet select (fnb-form-outlet), guest name (fnb-form-guest), table (fnb-form-table), party size (fnb-form-party), booking ID (fnb-form-booking), submit (fnb-form-submit)
Tab Detail view (fnb-tab-detail) with status badge, ref, total, items count
Action buttons when open: Kalem Ekle (fnb-add-item-btn), Outlet Transferi (fnb-transfer-btn), Kapat & Tahsil (fnb-close-btn)
Add Item form (fnb-add-form): name (fnb-add-name), qty (fnb-add-qty), price (fnb-add-price), note (fnb-add-note), submit (fnb-add-submit)
Transfer form (fnb-transfer-form): target outlet (fnb-transfer-outlet), table (fnb-transfer-table), submit (fnb-transfer-submit)
Close form (fnb-close-form): 5 payment buttons (fnb-pay-cash/card/room_folio/complimentary/voucher), tip (fnb-close-tip), discount (fnb-close-discount), submit (fnb-close-submit)
Items list (fnb-items-list) with delete buttons on open tabs
Transfers tab: list of transfer audit rows (fnb-transfers-list)
Dashboard tab: 5 KPI tiles + 2 bar charts (by outlet revenue, by payment method)
Sidebar: F&B Tab Transfer button (fnb-tabs-btn) with ForkKnife icon
